012/**
013 * <p>Title: ContributorStoryTests Class.</p>
014 * <p>Description: Named positive and negative scenarios derived from the supplied
015 * Contributor (Phase Two) stories. C01-C12 refer to RequirementsToTests.md.
016 * Each method documents its requirement, implementation, and output oracle.
017 * Runs inside LessonTestingAutomation on the JavaFX thread and its isolated H2
018 * connection. Admin is the privileged-role fixture; Phase Three AI behavior is
019 * design scope, not claimed as implemented.</p>
020 */
021public final class ContributorStoryTests {
022
023        /** Owner fixture; independent of the original regression suite's owner zero. */
024        private static final User owner = actor(101, false);
025        /** A different contributor used to challenge privacy enforcement. */
026        private static final User other = actor(102, false);
027        /** Admin represents the other role permitted to edit, delete, and lock. */
028        private static final User admin = actor(999, true);
029        /** Fixture identities removed after this suite, including failed scenarios. */
030        private static final List<Integer> created = new ArrayList<>();
031        /** Marker identifies the independent story fixture between JVMs. */
032        private static final Path restart = Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home"), "story-restart.txt");
033
034        /** Prevents construction of a static test suite. */
035        private ContributorStoryTests() { }
036
037        /** Creates a fixture identity without testing authentication.
038         * @param id fixture owner identity
039         * @param privileged whether this fixture represents an admin
040         * @return requesting user */
041        private static User actor(int id, boolean privileged) {
042                return new User(privileged ? "Story admin" : "Contributor " + id, "", "", "", "", "", "",
043                                privileged, !privileged, false, id);
044        }
045
046        /** Creates a valid core-content fixture and tracks it for cleanup.
047         * @return saved fixture
048         * @throws Exception if persistence fails */
049        private static Lesson fixture() throws Exception {
050                Lesson lesson = new Lesson(0, owner.getUserId(), "Story lesson", "A repeated attempt failed",
051                                "Revise the approach", "Initial attempt: reviewed design; 1 hour; Alex 1 person-hour");
052                created.add(ModelLessons.createLesson(lesson, owner));
053                return lesson;
054        }
055
056        /** Prints an independently named assertion and updates the Foundations-style totals.
057         * @param name scenario/method name
058         * @param passed whether the documented expectation was observed */
059        private static void check(String name, boolean passed) {
060                System.out.println("\nStory test " + name + ": " + (passed ? "Success" : "Failure"));
061                if (passed) LessonTestingAutomation.numPassed++;
062                else LessonTestingAutomation.numFailed++;
063        }
064
065        /** Checked action used to distinguish expected permission denial from other failures. */
066        @FunctionalInterface
067        private interface Action {
068                /** Executes the challenged operation.
069                 * @throws Exception if the operation fails */
070                void run() throws Exception;
071        }
072
073        /** Accepts only the documented security exception; SQL/programming errors propagate.
074         * @param action challenged actor-aware operation
075         * @return whether access was denied
076         * @throws Exception if a different failure occurs */
077        private static boolean denied(Action action) throws Exception {
078                try { action.run(); return false; }
079                catch (SecurityException expected) { return true; }
080        }
081
082        /** Runs every first-process story scenario and restores the previous view identity.
083         * @throws Exception if setup, cleanup, or an unexpected operation fails */
084        public static void run() throws Exception {
085                User previous = ViewLessons.currentUser;
086                try {
087                        testCreateValid(); testCreateInvalid();
088                        testOwnListAndRead(); testForeignAccessDenied();
089                        testOtherRoleEditVisible(); testOtherRoleDeletionVisible();
090                        testUnlockedEdit(); testLockedEditsAndIndicators();
091                        testUnlockedDelete(); testLockedDeletionDenied();
092                        testMetadataHidden(); testMetadataPreserved();
093                        testExperienceAppend(); testExperienceRejected();
094                        testExperienceHistoryButton(); testExperienceForeignOrLocked();
095                        testListOperations(); testListEdges();
096                        testBatchLocks(); testBatchRollback();
097                        testBoundaryAccepted(); testBoundaryRejected();
098                        prepareRestart();
099                } finally {
100                        for (int lessonId : created) FoundationsMain.database.deleteLesson(lessonId);
101                        created.clear();
102                        ViewLessons.currentUser = previous;
103                        ViewLessons.refreshList();
104                }
105        }
106
107        /** C01 positive: create valid core information through the actor-aware model.
108         * Success means generated identity, owner, and stored core fields agree.
109         * @throws Exception if fixture persistence fails */
110        public static void testCreateValid() throws Exception {
111                // C01-P: Check the saved record rather than relying on a returned ID alone.
112                Lesson lesson = fixture();
113                Lesson saved = ModelLessons.readLesson(lesson.getId(), owner);
114                check("C01-P testCreateValid", saved != null && saved.getId() > 0
115                                && saved.getOwnerId() == owner.getUserId() && saved.getProblem().equals(lesson.getProblem()));

183        /** C04 negative: test each individual lock and the whole-lesson lock.
184         * Success means programmatic edits are denied, GUI editability/labels agree, and
185         * title content is unchanged. Contributor lock controls are hidden and denied.
186         * @throws Exception if persistence or evidence fails */
187        public static void testLockedEditsAndIndicators() throws Exception {
188                for (ModelLessons.LessonField field : ModelLessons.LessonField.values()) {
189                        Lesson lesson = fixture();
190                        ModelLessons.toggleLock(lesson.getId(), field, admin);
191                        Lesson changed = ModelLessons.readLesson(lesson.getId(), owner);
192                        switch (field) {
193                                case TITLE -> changed.setTitle("Denied");
194                                case PROBLEM -> changed.setProblem("Denied");
195                                case SOLUTION -> changed.setSolution("Denied");
196                                case EXPERIENCE -> changed.setExperience("Denied");
197                        }
198                        ViewLessons.currentUser = owner;
199                        ViewLessons.showLesson(ModelLessons.readLesson(lesson.getId(), owner));
200                        boolean[] editable = {ViewLessons.text_Title.isEditable(), ViewLessons.text_Problem.isEditable(),
201                                        ViewLessons.text_Solution.isEditable(), ViewLessons.text_Experience.isEditable()};
202                        check("C04-N locked " + field, denied(() -> ModelLessons.updateLesson(changed, owner))
203                                        && !editable[field.ordinal()] && ViewLessons.fieldLabels[field.ordinal()].getText().contains("[locked]"));
204                }
205                Lesson whole = fixture();
206                ModelLessons.setLessonsLocked(List.of(whole.getId()), true, admin);
207                whole.setTitle("Denied whole edit");
208                check("C04-N whole lesson", denied(() -> ModelLessons.updateLesson(whole, owner))
209                                && ModelLessons.readLesson(whole.getId(), owner).getTitle().equals("Story lesson"));
210                check("C04-N contributor cannot change locks", denied(() -> ModelLessons.toggleLock(whole.getId(), ModelLessons.LessonField.TITLE, owner))
211                                && denied(() -> ModelLessons.setLessonsLocked(List.of(whole.getId()), false, owner)));
212                ViewLessons.displayLessons(ViewLessons.theStage, owner);
213                ViewLessons.showLesson(ModelLessons.readLesson(whole.getId(), owner));
214                check("C04-N admin controls hidden", !ViewLessons.lockButtons[0].isVisible() && !ViewLessons.button_LockSelected.isVisible());
215                capture("09-contributor-locked-fields");
216        }

357        /** C10 positive: batch-lock and unlock two lessons while retaining individual locks.
358         * Success means both whole locks change and the independent title lock survives.
359         * @throws Exception if persistence fails */
360        public static void testBatchLocks() throws Exception {
361                Lesson first = fixture(); Lesson second = fixture();
362                ModelLessons.toggleLock(first.getId(), ModelLessons.LessonField.TITLE, admin);
363                ModelLessons.setLessonsLocked(List.of(first.getId(), second.getId()), true, admin);
364                check("C10-P batch lock", ModelLessons.readLesson(first.getId(), admin).isLocked() && ModelLessons.readLesson(second.getId(), admin).isLocked());
365                ModelLessons.setLessonsLocked(List.of(first.getId(), second.getId()), false, admin);
366                check("C10-P batch unlock", !ModelLessons.readLesson(first.getId(), admin).isLocked()
367                                && !ModelLessons.readLesson(second.getId(), admin).isLocked() && ModelLessons.readLesson(first.getId(), admin).isTitleLocked());
368        }

371         * Success means SQL rejection leaves the valid record unlocked and permits later writes.

398        /** Prepares C08/C12's independent owner-77 record without affecting owner-zero counts.
399         * @throws Exception if saving the fixture or marker fails */
400        private static void prepareRestart() throws Exception {
401                Lesson lesson = new Lesson(0, 77, "Story restart", "P", "S", "");
402                lesson.create(FoundationsMain.database);
403                lesson.setLocked(true); lesson.setProblemLocked(true); lesson.setSearchTerms("PRIVATE RESTART");
404                lesson.setTimeHours(3); lesson.setEffortHours(4); lesson.setStatsVisible(true);
405                FoundationsMain.database.updateLessonLocks(lesson);
406                FoundationsMain.database.updateLessonMetadata(lesson);
407                lesson.addExperience(FoundationsMain.database, "Attempt one; time 1h; Alex 1 person-hour");
408                lesson.addExperience(FoundationsMain.database, "Attempt two; time 2h; Sam 2 person-hours");
409                Files.writeString(restart, Integer.toString(lesson.getId()));
410        }

413         * Success means these persisted values survive closing the original connection.

423                                && lesson.getTimeHours() == 3 && lesson.getEffortHours() == 4 && lesson.isStatsVisible());

426        /** C08/C12 negative: restart must not bypass locks or reveal restricted attributes.
427         * Success means edit/delete are denied and the contributor projection hides metadata.
428         * @throws Exception if fixture access or cleanup fails */
429        public static void testRestartKeepsRestrictions() throws Exception {
430                int lessonId = Integer.parseInt(Files.readString(restart));
431                User contributor = actor(77, false);
432                Lesson visible = ModelLessons.readLesson(lessonId, contributor);
433                visible.setTitle("Forbidden after restart");
434                check("C08-N testRestartKeepsRestrictions", denied(() -> ModelLessons.updateLesson(visible, contributor))
435                                && denied(() -> ModelLessons.deleteLesson(lessonId, contributor)));
436                check("C12-N future attributes restricted", visible.getSearchTerms().isEmpty()
437                                && visible.getTimeHours() == 0 && visible.getEffortHours() == 0 && !visible.isStatsVisible());
438                FoundationsMain.database.deleteLesson(lessonId);
439                Files.delete(restart);
440        }

447        /** Saves optional evidence of a real rendered node.
